page.overview:
Who is Titus Galvus?

Titus yae Galvus is an unseen character in Final Fantasy XIV. He is the youngest son of Solus zos Galvus, brother of Lucius yae Galvus, uncle of Varis zos Galvus, husband of Arrecina wir Galvus, and father of Nerva yae Galvus.

Titus vied for the throne against Varis following the death of Solus, but was ousted and Varis took the crown.

Following Zenos Galvus's resurrection, Titus and his son Nerva took advantage of the rumors to gain power.
